NOT PUBLISHED 2026-09-02. Baba Zakura is fully verified and its story already written (see data/research/otama-verified.json), but Otama Village stands at one tree, and the 2026-08-31 single-tree-destination exception does not reach it: would somebody travel specifically for this tree? It is a real National Natural Monument with a good legend (Minamoto no Yoshiie's tethering whip), but our own sources describe it as toppled by a 2018 storm and now blooming only sparsely from young branches, under active vitality-recovery work rather than as a spectacular sight. No source found frames it as a pilgrimage destination the way Miharu Takizakura or the other Three Great Cherry Trees are. So it waits here rather than being stretched into a page.

Do not re-verify it. If a future pass finds three more publicly reachable, verified trees in Otama Village or nearby, this one is ready to ship immediately, story and all.
